_comment: Extra sources. 'sheets' = PUBLIC Google Sheets (published to the web, or CSV links; anyone can open them, no sign-in). update_catalog.py lists every tab of a published sheet itself, downloads each tab as CSV, maps the columns (number, name, link, description, plus category/use/pricing/notes when a tab has them) and merges the rows into the catalog. 'tabs' is optional and only adds hints per tab (gid): 'hint' = category hint, 'tag' = extra tag. Never list a private, sign-in, email-signup or paid (Patreon) sheet here.
